question.en: Discuss the role of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) in supporting global economic stability through climate data and disaster risk reduction.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) in supporting global economic stability through climate data and disaster risk reduction.

modelAnswer.en: The WMO provides essential data for sectors like agriculture, aviation, and energy. By improving weather forecasting and climate monitoring, it helps nations mitigate the economic impact of natural disasters, thereby protecting infrastructure and food security.
